digest: Coverage centred on Max Verstappen's victory and the nature of the racing. Formula 1 counted 352 overtakes, but Lando Norris questioned how real they were (RaceFans), and the passes were both lauded and derided (Autosport). Russell's war of words with Verstappen drew a warning from Guenther Steiner (Motorsport.com), while Red Bull told Verstappen to consider letting Antonelli pass on the penultimate lap (RaceFans). Frederic Vasseur's post-race session on Leclerc and Hamilton mirrored Mexico (Autosport), and McLaren's boss defended Piastri's four-letter outburst (Motorsport.com).
